ABOUT THE ARTIST

Meet Janhavi.

For me, a design begins with a conversation. A bride might bring a favourite flower, a portrait idea or a wedding detail she wants to carry on her hands.

I’m Janhavi Gupta, a mehndi artist based in Varanasi. Over five years and more than 150 clients, I’ve developed a love for fine lines, thoughtful spacing and designs that feel personal.

Where Art Meets Elegance.

LEARN MEHNDI ONLINE

From the practice book.

Roll a mehndi cone

Fold a small cellophane rectangle into a cone. Slide its layers until the tip closes neatly. Tape the seam, fill halfway and fold the top closed. Test a fine line on paper.

Practise a jaali grid

Draw four parallel diagonal lines on paper. Cross them with evenly spaced diagonals. Add a dot at each intersection, then repeat with a finer grid.

Draw a floral mandala

Begin with a dot and surround it with a circle. Place four petals at equal intervals, fill the gaps with four more and finish the outer edge with small scallops.
